about.title:
Who we are.
Owner-managed since 1998.
about.lead: We are an owner-managed M&A boutique based in Zug. Since 1998, we have accompanied entrepreneurs through the critical transitions of their history — sale, acquisition, succession, restructuring. What distinguishes us from larger houses is not mandate volume — it is the attention we devote to each individual mandate.
about.quote: Many promise discretion. We prefer to describe how we work in practice – one page per mandate, encrypted data room, NDA at the beginning rather than the end, no public client list.

leistungen.heroDesc: BSF accompanies owner-managed mid-market companies across six clearly defined mandate types — discreet, structured, with undivided attention per mandate.
leistungen.introSub1: BSF Consulting AG accompanies mid-market companies across four clearly defined mandate fields – focus DACH and Turkey, national and international. No dual mandates, no conflicts of interest.
leistungen.introSub2: Since 1998, BSF Consulting AG has stood for discreet, owner-managed M&A advisory. Every mandate receives the full attention of the house.
leistungen.introItem1Sub: Within the family or externally, with sensitivity
leistungen.cardsTitle: We stand by your side in these six areas of expertise.
leistungen.cardsSub: BSF Consulting AG accompanies mid-sized companies in all essential M&A situations – discreetly, systematically, results-oriented.
leistungen.card0Desc: We bring your company to the right buyer — with a structured process, vetted prospects and maximum confidentiality. For transactions from CHF 5 million onwards.
leistungen.card1Desc: When the next generation takes over — or an external buyer continues the life's work. We accompany you through the often multi-year preparation, valuation and handover.
leistungen.card2Desc: Ordering structures before they become problematic. Holding establishment, group simplification or turnaround in crisis — we assist alongside tax advisors and lawyers.
leistungen.card3Desc: You wish to acquire, not sell? We identify suitable target companies in our active regions — from initial screening to Closing.
leistungen.grenzenTitle:
What we do —
and what we don't
leistungen.grenzenSub: Clear positioning protects your process. We accept only mandates we can accompany in their entirety.
leistungen.tu0: Accompany owner-managed mid-sized companies – from initial assessment to Closing
leistungen.tu1: Discreet buyer search without market exposure and without dual mandate
leistungen.tu2: Cross-border transactions with buyers and entrepreneurs in the DACH region and Turkey
leistungen.tu3: Succession advisory – family-internal and external – with sensitivity
leistungen.tu4: Restructuring advisory with a clear focus on preserving value
leistungen.nicht0: Publicly listed companies or capital-market-oriented transactions
leistungen.nicht1: Dual mandates in the same sector – freedom from conflicts of interest is non-negotiable
leistungen.nicht2: Hourly-based advisory without a clearly agreed outcome objective
leistungen.nicht3: Mass outreach without prior qualification of prospects
leistungen.ctaDesc: Find out in a complimentary initial consultation. Not a sales pitch – an honest assessment.

honorar.heroDesc: The initial consultation is free of charge. Specific terms are agreed after the first meeting — in writing, fairly, with a clear success component.
honorar.introSub1: BSF remunerates advisory as it should be: The principal portion of our fee is tied to your success – to the successful completion of your transaction.
honorar.introSub2: No hidden fine print, no hourly fees as an end in themselves. What we agree upon stands – transparent and traceable.
honorar.introItem0Sub: Payable exclusively upon successful Closing. Our interest is identical to yours.
honorar.introItem1Sub: Monthly flat fee for ongoing work – depending on mandate complexity and duration.
honorar.introItem2Sub: Free of charge, non-binding – secured by NDA upon request.
honorar.bausteineSub: Our fee is based on mandate complexity and transaction size – always agreed transparently.
honorar.scard0Desc: When we successfully complete your mandate, we receive a percentage of the transaction volume — agreed in writing in advance.
honorar.scard1Desc: Over the mandate duration. Covers our advisory, preparation, market approach and negotiation management.
honorar.scard2Desc: We get to know each other, assess your situation and provide honest advice – even if a mandate does not suit us.
honorar.phaseSub: From assessment to Closing – what BSF Consulting AG delivers at each phase and how it is remunerated.
honorar.faq0Q: How is the success fee structured?
honorar.faq0A: The principal portion of remuneration is contingent upon the successful completion of the transaction – typically as a tiered percentage of the final purchase price. The precise structure is agreed individually and is fully transparent. We discuss details in the initial meeting.
honorar.faq1Q: Is there a minimum transaction size?
honorar.faq1A: BSF Consulting AG advises mid-market companies. As a guideline, we typically work from a transaction volume of approximately CHF 2 million. Exceptions are possible for clearly structured mandates – please contact us.
honorar.faq2Q: What does the initial meeting cost?
honorar.faq2A: Nothing. The first meeting is complimentary, entirely non-binding and, if desired, immediately subject to a confidentiality agreement. You may also contact us anonymously.
honorar.faq3Q: When exactly does the success fee become due?
honorar.faq3A: Exclusively upon successful Closing – i.e. upon execution of the purchase agreement and completion of the transaction. Should the transaction not close, only the retainer for process work performed becomes due – depending on the agreed structure.
honorar.ctaDesc: No charge, no obligation, confidential. We explain precisely what to expect.

methode.heroDesc: Every mandate follows five clear phases — from the first assessment to closing. Guided by principles unchanged since 1998.
methode.introSub: BSF Consulting AG thinks and acts like an owner – not like an external consultant. Our four principles are not marketing promises, but the lived rules of every mandate.
methode.cardsSub: What defines every BSF Consulting AG mandate – from first contact through to Closing.
methode.card0Title: We represent only one side — yours
methode.card0Desc: No equity, no participation, no conflicts of interest. We represent your interests exclusively – with full transparency at every stage of the process.
methode.card1Title: What we discuss remains between us
methode.card1Desc: NDA from the very first meeting. All processes, documents and communication channels are treated in strict confidence – the market and competitors learn nothing.
methode.card2Desc: Sector expertise meets years of network competence. In DACH and Turkey, we maintain active relationships with qualified buyers, sellers and partners.
methode.card3Desc: No hourly consultancy fees as an end in themselves. Our fee structure is predominantly success-based – our interest is identical to yours: a successful Closing.
methode.bandDesc: Our structured process guides you safely through all phases: assessment, preparation, buyer search, negotiation, Closing.
methode.phasenSub: Five clear phases. No client is left in the dark.
methode.phase0Desc: Initial consultation, NDA upon request, preliminary valuation assessment. You learn whether and how BSF can help.
methode.phase1Desc: Information memorandum, teaser, structured data room – ensuring your company is presented optimally.
methode.phase2Desc: Identification, discreet approach and screening of qualified parties of interest. Letter of Intent (LOI).
methode.phase3Desc: Due diligence coordination, SPA negotiations, support throughout all legal and financial review stages.
methode.phase4Desc: Signing, transfer of ownership, post-closing support – the moment everything has been working towards.
methode.quoteText:
"From initial conversation to closing —
guided, not rushed."
methode.ctaDesc: Complimentary, non-binding, confidential. The first conversation is yours.

transaktionsuhr.heroDesc: Our proprietary algorithm calculates the quarterly cycle position of 14 economic sectors — seller's market, cooling, trough or upturn.
transaktionsuhr.introSub1: The BSF Transaction Clock analyses 14 economic sectors on a quarterly basis, assigning each to one of four market phases: Peak, Cooling, Trough and Recovery.
transaktionsuhr.introSub2: The result: a visual map of the M&A climate – sector-specific, without investment advice, updated quarterly. A compass for clients who do not leave the right moment to chance.
transaktionsuhr.phase0Sub: Valuations at their highest – optimal phase for sellers
transaktionsuhr.phase2Sub: Acquisition window open – favourable phase for buyers
transaktionsuhr.phase3Sub: Activity rising – mandates should be opened now
transaktionsuhr.detailDefault: Click on a sector in the clock to view details on the current market position.
transaktionsuhr.detailHint: Full analysis including methodology and recommendation available to clients after initial meeting.
transaktionsuhr.legendSub: Click on a sector to view its current position.
transaktionsuhr.legendHoch: Valuations at the upper end, M&A activity high. Favourable phase for sellers — multiples at peak, buyers paying premiums.
transaktionsuhr.legendAbkuehlung: Multiples declining, buyers becoming more selective. Recommendation: structure now, act in 6–12 months.
transaktionsuhr.legendTief: Valuations low, acquisition window open. Favourable phase for buyers with a long-term horizon.
transaktionsuhr.legendAufschwung: Activity increasing, competition rising. Mandates should be opened soon — the window is opening.
transaktionsuhr.quoteText:
"The market always has a rhythm — measured quarterly, reported by sector.
Edition 2/2025 is current."
transaktionsuhr.ctaDesc: Detailed sector commentary, sources, methodology and recommendations available to clients after initial meeting — complimentary and confidential.

booking.headline: Request initial consultation

booking.p1Sub: No sensitive details necessary — we shall clarify the framework in a personal conversation.
booking.briefPh: In a few sentences — what is this about? You need not mention any sensitive details.
booking.briefNote: Confidential. This information is transmitted in encrypted form.
booking.p2Sub: Help us better assess your situation.
booking.compPh: If you wish to mention it now — confidential

booking.consentText: I acknowledge that my enquiry will be treated confidentially. BSF Consulting AG undertakes not to disclose any information to third parties.
booking.successMsg: Thank you. We will contact you personally within one business day.
